# National Packers & Movers

> India's premier relocation and logistics enterprise since 1987. Founded by Debabrata Jhampaty, headquartered in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, serving Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Bihar, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, and pan-India destinations.

## Core Relocation Services
- [Household Relocation](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/household-relocation): Complete home shifting with 7-layer protective packaging and dedicated lockable containers.
- [Corporate Relocation](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/corporate-relocation): Zero-downtime office moving, IT infrastructure, server rack transport, and modular workstation assembly.
- [Industrial Relocation](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/industrial-relocation): Heavy plant machinery, factory equipment, and raw material transport across Eastern India.
- [Vehicle Relocation](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/vehicle-relocation): Specialized enclosed car carriers and two-wheeler door-to-door transport.
- [Warehousing & Storage](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/warehousing-storage): 24/7 CCTV-monitored, moisture-proof short and long-term storage facilities.
- [Transit Insurance](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/services/transit-insurance): 100% comprehensive declared-value transit protection policy against transit loss.

## Online Tools & Customer Portals
- [Instant Quote Calculator](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/get-quote): Online moving estimate calculator for house, vehicle, and office moves.
- [Consignment Tracking](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/track-shipment): Real-time shipment status and GPS milestone tracking by consignment number.
- [PSU Billing & Claims Kit](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/billing-claim-kit): 100% IBA-compliant GST invoices and claim assistance for Coal India, SAIL, NTPC, and SBI officer transfers.
- [Branch Network Directory](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/branches): Regional branch hubs across Dhanbad, Kolkata, Ranchi, Patna, Lucknow, Varanasi, and 1,200+ cities.
- [Customer Testimonials](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/testimonials): 1,250+ verified customer reviews with a 4.9 out of 5 satisfaction rating.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/faqs): Comprehensive FAQ covering rates, packing timelines, insurance, and transit protocols.
- [About National Packers & Movers](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/about): Corporate history since 1987, founder Debabrata Jhampaty, fleet details, and trust credentials.
- [Contact Central Dispatch](https://www.thenationalpackersmovers.com/contact): Central dispatch helplines (+91-9835168368 / +91-9934166164) and corporate headquarters at Kasturba Nagar, Near Dhanbad Thana, Dhanbad.
